styles.name: Slug & Lettuce chef jacket, mandarin collar — short sleeve, black, S&L logo on the left chest
styles.desc: Chef jacket with mandarin collar · Short sleeve · Concealed stud fastening · Panelled back · Pen pocket on left sleeve as worn · Black · S&L logo 80 mm embroidered in white to the left chest as worn
styles.lectra: 0193NEW — variant 0193NEWSS (cut standard pen pocket from waste)
fabrics: Black 65% polyester / 35% cotton 195 gsm (P and R)
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
10 x nickel plated ring press studs. Concealed female studs set to left front as worn, set before make-up. After make-up set male studs: align fronts and mark for male studs.
Set to left side seam as worn, 10 cm up from cut hem, to finish 8 cm from finished hem.
Set centrally to back panel, 4 cm down from finished neck seam. Edgestitch in position in same colour as garment.
Set to centre back neck into neck seam, on top of care label.
Tibard pre-printed care label / size: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · tumble dry · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean. Set underneath the Tibard centre fold label at centre back neck.
mfg: Cutting: cut the standard pen pocket from waste. Set the female studs (x 10) pre-make-up — concealed, left front as worn.
Set pen pocket hem. Double turn and topstitch 1.5 cm.
Edgestitch pen pocket to left sleeve as worn. Set top of pocket 10 cm down from cut edge of sleeve. Back side of pocket to be in line with centre of sleeve.
Stitch a centre divide to pen pocket.
Set Tibard label to back of jacket.
Join up on 5 thread. Neaten front facing edge. Join back panels, join shoulders, set collar, set sleeves, join underarm / side seam. Insert labels. Neaten body hem.
Set front facing. Stitch at width 13 cm from hem up and run up to neck, 6 mm topstitch back neck and then back down front. Ensure fronts lie flat.
Set body hem. Turn up 1.7 cm. Topstitch 1.5 cm.
Set short sleeve hem: double turn (1 cm + 1.6 cm) and topstitch 1.5 cm.
styles.tol: Chest ± 2 cm · Sleeve length ± 1 cm · Back length ± 1.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: S&L logo, design "Slug (SL June 19) - 8cm", embroidered to the left chest as worn in white. Design 80.4 mm wide x 35.8 mm high, 4524 stitches, 2 colour changes, both needles Madeira Polyneon 40 colour 1801 (white): needle 1 S&L letters 1992 st, needle 2 2532 st; thread 22.2 m, bobbin 7.4 m, 4 trims. The stock black short sleeve jacket (CICJ0193, black) is picked from stock and embroidered after make-up; nothing is cut or made on this works order.
styles.note: Tibard embroidery form E861486 (Jamie-Leigh, issued 27/5/26 for Slug and Lettuce Solihull, required 8/6/26): "S&L 80mm embroidered logo on left chest in white" on CICJ01935203. The Sage codes SLCICJ0193XS03 to XL03 and 5203/5403/5603 are the stock CICJ0193--03 with the S&L logo; applies to all stock chef jackets ordered under the SL prefix. Record cloned from CICJ0193--03 with the branding added, 27 Nov 2026. Logo photo from the form; design details from the Wilcom sheet SlugSL June 19 8cm.png.
